main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: Gnosis allows us to free ourselves from matter
header_desc: The Gnostic gospels hold the key to solving one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity. In this framework, consciousness manifests through two fundamental states —| ONE❤️ ⟩ the | EGO 🧠 ⟩—, granting us a free will of perception that can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨ ONE ❤️, EGO 🧠 ⟩, thus revealing that we harbor the divine spark within.
left_title: The Awakening of Sophia: From the Prison of Yaldabaoth to the Realm of Light
left_body: In general relativity, matter tells spacetime how to curve and spacetime tells matter how to move. Similarly, the demiurgic ego exerts its own gravity: its density distorts your inner fabric and weaves the materio-temporal illusion of the psyche. Therefore, only through the wisdom of Sophia is it possible to transcend that curvature and return to the divine and timeless plane of the cosmos, in the purity of the pneuma. Under this light, the sentence "the Father and I are one" is a call to dissolve the "false self" to return to the Realm of pure light where the Invisible Father resides.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end but a transformation liberates us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere, our pneuma resides in the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is within you and outside of you (Gospel of Thomas, Saying 3). Pistis Sophia represents the right hemisphere, while the demiurge Yaldabaoth embodies the left, thus revealing the fundamental duality of human consciousness.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. Gravitational force drags us to a place where: war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength (1984).
final_quote: When the Northern Eagle and the Southern Condor fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and humanity will heal
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: A Journey through Gnosis and Physics
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and integration framework: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and the mind). The call for balance to initiate evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and the Illusion of Time (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity versus Quantum Mechanics. Why Newton's and Maxwell's laws do not distinguish between past and future, Einstein's break from simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The Faggin--Segarra conceptual ensemble: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside spacetime, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not arise from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Intelligent Designer free of time and space.
cap4_desc: The discovery of Nag Hammadi (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as a home, but as the confinement of the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to establish a religion of dogmas, but to free the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Realm of Light and The Prison of the Demiurge (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth —also known as the great architect of matter— is the creator of the sensible world, a self-centered god ignorant of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Compared eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as the cognitive prison of the ego, compared to Jesus' revolutionary message that dismantles the imperial slavery system.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: In the end, the great paradox boils down to this: in the vastness of the cosmos —with its more than two trillion galaxies— this is where the phrase of Jesus resonates most strongly: "The Father and I are one." Could this have held a hidden message about the deep connection between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: The idea that God is a white man, larger than usual, with a blazing beard, sitting in heaven counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one means the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it doesn't make much sense to pray to the law of gravity
